text:
QUOTE: Archiving a channel | `archiveChannel` in `app/actions/remote/channel.ts:1390` | Sets `delete_at` locally, so the channel stays in the local DB as archived | Removes the current user from the channel locally; and "If the user is viewing that channel, kicks them out (`Events.CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`), then removes the user from the channel"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that with the flag off (not viewable) the user is removed and kicked out if viewing the channel, while with the flag on the channel stays with delete_at set (marked deleted).
